name: MomentBackup-Hub
description: A private overview of MomentBackup protection. The Hub stores no backup data and starts in heartbeat-reporting mode.

paths.name: Hub data
paths.description: The Hub identity, accounts, machine trust, notification queue, and audit history. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Hub HTTPS port
ports.description: The private HTTPS dashboard and machine-reporting port.

variables.name: Hub HTTPS address
variables.description: The exact HTTPS origin every computer uses. Replace this placeholder with this server's IP address before first start. An IP is the safest choice: it needs no name resolution, so it works from every computer and from inside the Hub container, which has no mDNS resolver and cannot resolve a .local name at all — the container health check asks this address for the Hub's readiness, so a name the container cannot resolve makes a working Hub report as unhealthy. Changing this later requires enrolling every computer again.

variables.name: Machine reporting
variables.description: Allow enrolled MomentBackup apps to report their status.

variables.name: Backup scan folders
variables.description: Empty means heartbeat mode. Add only container paths to read-only backup mounts if you deliberately configure disk scanning.

variables.name: Private TLS
variables.description: The Hub creates a private certificate that each enrolled MomentBackup app pins.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: The time zone used for dates shown to the owner.
